items.title: Jimmy Cobb — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Eleana is my wife. She put out – we made this record. She produced this record.

ctx.x: Did you know – a lot of that came through Frank Wess. I think Frank was the first one, and he turned the Count on to these other guys

That’s probably right. I had a – I was in a band with Frank. We had a quartet. I was in his quartet. Recently he sent a photo that we had taken together, which was about – by the time I got it, it was about 50 years old. We’re looking [?]. We used it on one of our CDs that we put out – that Eleana put out. Eleana is my wife. She put out – we made this record. She produced this record. On the front of it is me, looking like I’m 18, which
I was, and a big bass drum. But they cut off the rest of the picture, which was him and a piano player named Rob Harley.
